A '''city''' located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jabiim/Legends|Jabiim]] was [[Destruction of a Jabiimi city|destroyed]] by a [[Force storm (weather)|Force storm]] generated by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Fulminiss]]<ref name="Fulminiss" /> sometime between [[3681 BBY]]<ref name="Timeline 6" /> and [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="Time" /> Fulminiss's actions were in response to the local [[Jabiimi]]'s resistance to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] rule of their world.<ref name="Fulminiss" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[City/Legends|city]] and its destruction were first mentioned in the Codex entry for Fulminiss within ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Fulminiss" />
